app.name: ClothUp

reason.carryLayer: It cools down later (feels like {{min}}°), so bring a layer.
reason.layers: Wear layers: it feels like {{min}}° to {{max}}° while you're out.
reason.rain: {{p}}% chance of rain: waterproof outer layer and closed shoes.
reason.rainWindy: Rain with strong wind: a hood works better than an umbrella.
reason.snow: Snow or freezing cold (feels like {{min}}°): warm coat, boots, gloves.
reason.cold: Cold (feels like {{min}}°): wool and warm layers, cover your neck and hands.
reason.hot: Hot (up to {{max}}°): light, breathable fabrics and light colors.
reason.humid: Humid heat: loose linen and cotton let your skin breathe.
reason.extremeHeat: Extreme heat ({{max}}°): cover up from the sun and carry water.
reason.uvHat: Shade your face and neck with a hat.
reason.dust: Dusty air: protect your eyes and wear closed shoes.
reason.sandstorm: Sandstorm risk: cover your face, eyes, arms and legs.
reason.windy: Gusty wind (up to {{gust}} km/h): windproof layers, avoid floaty pieces.
reason.modest: Modest: loose fit, long sleeves, full-length hems and a hijab that suits the temperature.
reason.traditional: Traditional Jordanian style with shemagh and iqal.
reason.religious: Respectful coverage for a religious visit.
reason.formalJacket: A tailored jacket completes a formal look.
reason.bisht: A bisht over the thobe for a formal occasion.
reason.university: Comfortable for a long day on campus.
reason.gym: Sportswear that moves with you and dries fast.
reason.hiking: Trail-ready: grippy shoes, sun protection and water.
reason.travel: Comfortable for travelling: easy shoes and layers.
reason.snowGround: Snow on the ground: boots with good grip.
reason.fog: Fog: a water-resistant layer keeps the damp out.
reason.dryWind: Dry, hot desert wind: cover up and carry water.
reason.sunShade: Warm in the sun but cool in the shade: bring a light layer.
reason.condolence: Quiet, dark colors and modest cuts for a condolence visit.
reason.interview: Sharp and tailored to make a good first impression.
reason.eid: Your best for Eid: festive colors and embroidery.
reason.iftar: Comfortable and modest for a long evening with family.
reason.dinner: Smart but relaxed for dinner out.
reason.shopping: Comfortable shoes for walking and a layer for the cold mall air.
reason.beach: Swimwear, sun protection and water for the beach.
reason.beachCool: Too cool to swim: a comfortable outfit for a walk by the water.
reason.officeAC: Strong air conditioning indoors: bring a light layer.
reason.personalCold: You feel the cold, so this is a little warmer than the forecast alone suggests.
reason.personalHot: You feel the heat, so this is a little lighter than the forecast alone suggests.
reason.personalAge: A slightly warmer pick with comfortable shoes, as suits your age group.
reason.personalFit: Relaxed, easy fits that are comfortable all day.

why.linen: the coolest fabric for hot days
why.chiffon: light and airy in the heat

note.neutral-accent: {{A}} and {{b}} make a calm base; {{c}} adds one touch of color.

note.complementary: {{A}} and {{b}} are opposite on the color wheel and balance each other out.
note.monochrome: Shades of one color ({{a}}) look polished and make you look taller.
note.hijab: The {{a}} hijab ties the outfit's colors together.
note.pair: {{A}} and {{b}} are an easy pair that always works.
note.light: Light colors reflect the sun and keep you cooler.
note.neutrals: {{A}}, {{b}} and {{c}} are calm neutrals that always work together.
note.pattern: The {{a}}-and-{{b}} pattern is the one busy piece; everything else stays plain.
